(a) Types of Driving Means. The driving means shall be one of the following types:

(1) traction

(2) winding drum (see Section 5.3.1.16.3)

(3) direct plunger hydraulic (see Section 5.3.2)

(4) roped-hydraulic (see Section 5.3.2)

(5) screw machine (see Section 5.3.1.16.4)

(6) rack-and-pinion, in jurisdictions enforcing NBCC
